text:
[Council File 26-1214; CD 10]
Motion (Hutt – Lee) relative to expanding Overnight Parking District No. 551 to include the area bounded by Western Avenue, West 27th Street, Cimarron Street, and West 31 Street.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Expand Overnight Parking District No. 551 to include the area bounded by Western Avenue, West 27th Street, Cimarron Street, and West 31st Street in Council District 10.
